notes: Two points side by side now really do go side by side: slide a socket up to another and it clicks edge to edge instead of landing on top of it.
A dashed guide shows what a point has locked onto — the touching edge, the same height, or in line above or below.
Arrow keys nudge the selected point 10 mm, or 1 mm with Shift.
Zoom in and the step gets finer: 50 mm across a whole wall, 10 mm closer in, 1 mm right up close. Doors and windows on the floor plan too.
A switch directly above a socket still lines up on its centre.
